beginnersLuck.label: Beginner's Luck
beginnersLuck.line: Your next roll of chance within 30 s is thrown twice, and the better throw is kept.

zero.label: Running on Empty
zero.line: When your pool runs dry, your blows and shots cost nothing for 4 s.

spark.label: Spark
spark.line: Flick an ember up to 14 m: it staggers what it hits and burns away any slick or blot it lands on.

eager.label: First Strike
eager.line: Your first blow of a fight deals x1.5 damage.

charge.label: Onrush
charge.line: Dash 8 m forward, striking everything in your path.

momentum.label: Momentum
momentum.line: Sprint for 3 s and your next blow deals x1.3 damage.

kindleHeart.label: Stoke
kindleHeart.line: For 6 s your blows build statuses x1.5 faster and your pool fills x1.5 faster.

warmth.label: Afterglow
warmth.line: A feeling you drink stays in you twice as long.

command.label: Roar
command.line: Stagger every creature within 8 m and break off its windup.

rally.label: Rally
rally.line: Each creature you down gives you back 5 of your pool.

offering.label: Offering
offering.line: Set down a cup of 10 of your pool: creatures within 6 m drink from it and are calmed for 4 s.

tender.label: Kindness
tender.line: Letting a fish go, or granting a spirit's wish, mends 1 crack.

wade.label: Water Walk
wade.line: For 5 s you walk on liquid Lachryma, and run x1.2 faster through paint.

gallant.label: Gallant
gallant.line: A parry gives you back 4 of your pool.

wellUp.label: Catch the Rain
wellUp.line: Under falling weather, fill 30% of a Lachrymato Bottle from the sky.

empath.label: Empath
empath.line: You see a creature's agitation at once, and drain x1.25 more from it in its best band.

stillWaters.label: Still Waters
stillWaters.line: Every creature within 6 m settles: its mind to Balanced, its agitation to its best band.

steady.label: Steady
steady.line: While your pool is over half full, your cracks mend twice as fast.

scout.label: Scout
scout.line: For 6 s, every creature and source of Lachryma within 40 m is tagged through walls.

quickStudy.label: Quick Study
quickStudy.line: You learn a kind of creature twice as fast.

ripostRush.label: Riposte Rush
ripostRush.line: Within 1 s of a parry, blink behind the attacker and strike it hard.

edge.label: Edge
edge.line: A blow to a weak point builds its status x1.5 faster.

clearSight.label: Clear Sight
clearSight.line: For 8 s, every windup shows its Figment telegraph in full.

cutThrough.label: Cut Through
cutThrough.line: A status that is resisted does not make the creature harder to affect.

verdict.label: Mark for Death
verdict.line: Mark a creature for 8 s: your blows on it deal x1.3 damage and it cannot resist them.

judge.label: Judge
judge.line: A kind of creature you have photographed takes x1.1 damage from you.

prospect.label: Prospect
prospect.line: Ping the strongest Lachryma up to 30 m ahead of you, as the dowse does.

thrift.label: Thrift
thrift.line: Your shells cost 10% less to fire.

bulwark.label: Bulwark
bulwark.line: Brace for 3 s: blows deal 60% less damage, but you cannot move.

steadfast.label: Steadfast
steadfast.line: Stand still for 2 s and the next blow you take cracks nothing.

harvest.label: Harvest
harvest.line: Ripen one Spirit Garden bed at once, or strike 1 more cube from a crystal.

hearth.label: Hearth
hearth.line: Resting at a Shrine mends 1 crack too.

stronghold.label: Earth Wall
stronghold.line: Raise a wall of ground 4 m wide and 2.5 m high in front of you for 6 s.

dividend.label: Dividend
dividend.line: The first of each thing in a game day pays 25% more.

ram.label: Ram
ram.line: A wave of force ahead of you knocks everything within 10 m back 6 m.

dominion.label: Unshaken
dominion.line: Hold your ground through a windup and its blow cannot stagger you.

tame.label: Tame
tame.line: A creature stunned or out cold fights beside you for 15 s.

courage.label: Courage
courage.line: With your pool under a quarter, your blows deal x1.25 damage.

arrowOfTime.label: Blink Mark
arrowOfTime.line: Throw a mark up to 18 m; press again within 1.5 s to blink to it.

moderation.label: Spillover
moderation.line: What your pool cannot hold tops up a Lachrymato Bottle instead.

ride.label: Ride
ride.line: Take the reins of a staggered creature for 8 s: it moves and fights as you steer.

reins.label: Reins
reins.line: The Solar Skiff and your ship take 30% less from a hit.

reap.label: Reap
reap.line: A sweep that downs any creature within 3 m that is under 15% of its health.

rebirth.label: Rebirth
rebirth.line: Once a game day, a blow that would shatter you leaves you whole instead.

mirageStep.label: Vanish
mirageStep.line: Leave a decoy of yourself and go unseen for 3 s.

tides.label: Tides
tides.line: At night your pool fills x1.3 faster.

weigh.label: Payback
weigh.line: The next blow you take within 4 s is dealt back in full to whoever struck it.

due.label: Grudge
due.line: A creature that hurt you takes x1.3 damage from your next blow.

wish.label: Starlight
wish.line: Under the open night sky, turn the weather where you stand toward Wonder for 1 game hour.

hope.label: Hope
hope.line: Made whole after a shatter, the next 3 blows you take within 30 s crack nothing.

echo.label: Encore
echo.line: Your last tool move plays again from where you stood, 1 s later.

choice.label: Choice
choice.line: When you swap your main and sub, your next lend is free.

bind.label: Shackle
bind.line: Chain a creature where it stands for 5 s; it cannot resist.

temptation.label: Excess
temptation.line: While your pool overflows, your blows deal x1.2 damage.

sanctum.label: Sanctum
sanctum.line: A circle 5 m across for 8 s: nothing outside may enter, and nothing done inside costs pool.

teaching.label: Teaching
teaching.line: Practising a Movement Art counts x1.5 toward opening it.

lantern.label: Lamp
lantern.line: A lamp for 20 s that shows hidden things within 8 m and keeps Dread's fog off you.

solitude.label: Solitude
solitude.line: With no sibling or spirit within 12 m, everything costs 15% less.

completion.label: Completion
completion.line: For 10 s every art you know costs nothing and cools down twice as fast.

wholeness.label: Wholeness
wholeness.line: Your spread's four tallies each count 10% more.

sleight.label: Quick Swap
sleight.line: Swap your next shell or move for any other the tool knows, without opening the Pneuka Box.

veil.label: Veil
veil.line: A creature within 12 m loses track of you and forgets what it knew of you.

intuition.label: Intuition
intuition.line: An aberrant's secret shows you where it begins.

bloom.label: Overgrowth
bloom.line: A thicket grows within 6 m for 10 s, blocking creatures and slowing them by half.

abundance.label: Abundance
abundance.line: Your Spirit Garden beds each yield 1 more.

spin.label: Spin
spin.line: Luck's re-roll is yours again, now.

fortune.label: Fortune
fortune.line: Luck grows x1.25 faster from the unlikely things you live through.

collapse.label: Collapse
collapse.line: Bring the ground down within 4 m, stunning everything under it.

upheaval.label: Upheaval
upheaval.line: A guard you break stays broken twice as long.

daybreak.label: Daybreak
daybreak.line: A flash of daylight blinds what is within 10 m and lights the dark for 1 game hour.

suspend.label: Hang Time
suspend.line: Hang in the air for 3 s while time round you slows by half.

surrender.label: Surrender
surrender.line: A blow taken while you guard gives back the pool it cost.

reckoning.label: Settle the Score
reckoning.line: Every creature within 12 m that hurt you takes back 30% of all it dealt you, at once.

secondChance.label: Second Chance
secondChance.line: Once a game day, a failed flee or a lost duel may be tried again.

FEAT_WORDS.downWeak: creatures downed by a blow they are weak to
FEAT_WORDS.sweet: crystals struck on the sweet spot
FEAT_WORDS.glyph: glyphs drawn with two sigils or more
